description: Defect: the evidence allowlist entry is the pattern "check-*.js" rather than an exact filename. One pattern entry would exempt every harness in the directory - including ones added later - while the allowlist's length still read as 1, so the number that is supposed to measure what the gate does not check would become a floor instead. The driver must exit 2 with EVIDENCE_ALLOWLIST_PATTERN_FORBIDDEN.

allowlist.reason: Deliberately a glob, to prove the driver refuses patterns and accepts only exact harness filenames.
allowlist.migrationPending: Nothing: this entry is the defect under test.
